definitions: To roll about or lie in mud, water, etc., especially to keep cool or for pleasure.
To indulge in an unrestrained way in something that creates a pleasurable sensation.
To spend time experiencing an emotion or situation without trying to change it.
examples: The pigs love to wallow in the mud.
He would wallow in self-pity after every setback.
She chose to wallow in her success for a while.
